rows.reasoning: The only source is Blakespear's authored SB 1216 (2023-2024), chaptered law, which restricts state Active Transportation Program funding and on-street installation of Class III bikeways (sharrows) on higher-speed roads. This sets a bikeway design/safety standard within the existing active transportation program; it does not address 'Where should government focus its transportation investment' between road capacity and pedestrian, cycling, or transit priority, so it is adjacent to every rung.
